title: WavCube: Unifying Speech Representation for Understanding and Generation via Semantic-Acoustic Joint Modeling
abstract: WavCube proposes a compact 128-dimensional, 50Hz continuous speech latent derived from WavLM-Large that aims to support speech understanding, reconstruction, and generation in a single representation. The method first compresses high-dimensional SSL features into a semantic bottleneck, then injects acoustic details through reconstruction while semantic anchoring keeps the representation close to the frozen SSL manifold. Experiments show strong SUPERB understanding performance, competitive reconstruction, improved zero-shot TTS WER and speaker similarity, faster DiT convergence, and better SUPERB-SG generation performance than VAE-style acoustic baselines.
